description: This file contains utility functions for detecting currency codes in the Apache Superset project, including detection from dataframes, column configurations, and data sources, primarily for dynamic currency formatting.

methods.name: has_auto_currency_in_column_config
methods.description: Checks if any column in the provided form data has an AUTO currency format.

methods.name: detect_currency_from_df
methods.description: Detects a single currency code from a pandas DataFrame column if all entries are the same.

methods.name: detect_currency
methods.description: Detects a currency code from a data source by executing a lightweight query to determine if all filtered data contains a single currency.
